text:
Zoe (People Ops): Heads-up: Marta (visitor) arriving ~3:10pm with a rolled portfolio + a small plant. Shes bringing her partner who needs a low-sensory spot. Also, UPS left a box earlier labeled "Suite 3A" but our office is 3C — can someone move it to Mailroom pickup? Kiosk sometimes drops the photo step. Can we have manual badge ready and a comfy seat by the shaded bench? Thanks! :wave:

Sam (Front Desk): On it. Kiosk returning 502 for me. I can do manual badges. Where should the UPS box go if it's not claimed?

CourierBot: Delivery log: UPS left package at 10:12am, recipient label: Suite 3A. Status: left at front desk.

Priya: I moved that box to Mailroom 2 earlier and tagged it "misdelivered - route to 3A". Left a sticky note for Logistics.

Zoe (People Ops): Perfect — add "hold for Marta arrival 3:10" to the label. Seating: shaded bench by the big ficus is preferred. Please avoid fluorescent lights; bring a small blanket.

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge fallback (kiosk down):
```
# manual visitor badge quickflow
/usr/bin/cam-capture --out /tmp/marta.jpg --quality 70
/usr/local/bin/visitor_badge --name "Marta" --role Visitor --photo /tmp/marta.jpg --expires 8h > /tmp/marta_badge.pdf
lp -d Badge_Printer /tmp/marta_badge.pdf
```
I'll also spin up a guest_wifi token for 8h.

BadgePrinterBot: NOTICE - scheduled print queue at 3:07pm, estimated 5s.

Sam (Front Desk): Printer printed at 3:08 but the lanyard supply is low. We have clip-on only for now. Marta ok with clip?

Marta (Visitor): Clip is fine! Thanks for the heads up. My partner would prefer the bench, please.

Priya: Bench prepped with a soft throw and a small side table with water. I dimmed the lamp nearby.

Sam (Front Desk): Marta checked in at 3:09, ID verified, badge issued (clip-on). UPS box labeled and moved to Mailroom 2 with note to Logistics. Left a note on box: "Hold until Marta arrival - possible artwork inside". :white_check_mark:

Marta (Visitor): Thank you all! I taped a tiny spare hanging hook inside the portfolio tube labeled "hang - north beam" for the install team. Also left a note in the crate for Facilities.

Zoe (People Ops): Added hook note to the install checklist and pinged Facilities. Quick poll: leave a small bottle of water on the side table? :thumbsup: yes / :no_entry: no

Marta (Visitor): :thumbsup:

Sam (Front Desk): Water placed. All set. Closing thread appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
